```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd

from pipeline.filepaths import COUPLES

df = pd.read_parquet(COUPLES)
ed = df.dropna(subset=["hypo"])
```

The register file holds `{python} f"{len(df):,}"` first-birth couples, born
between `{python} str(df.year.min())` and `{python} str(df.year.max())`. Both
partners' education is recorded for `{python} f"{len(ed):,}"` of them, and in
`{python} f"{ed.hypo.mean():.1%}"` of those the mother is the more educated
partner.
